sections.heading: Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences Fees Structure 2025

content.text: The Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences fees are competitive and vary by course. Here is the detailed course-wise fee structure for 2025:

items: The B.Sc. Cardiac Care Technology course is priced at Four Lakhs for the first year and Two Lakhs each for the second and third years, summing up to a total of Eight Lakhs.

The B.Sc. Medical Imaging Technology and B.Sc. Anaesthesia & OT Technology programs each cost Two Lakhs Fifty Thousand for the first year and Two Lakhs per year for the next two years, totaling Six Lakhs Fifty Thousand.
The B.Sc. Perfusion Technology course is the most affordable with One Lakh Sixty Thousand for the first year and Sixty Thousand annually for the next two years, totaling Two Lakhs Eighty Thousand.

B.Sc. Respiratory Care Technology and B.Sc. Renal Dialysis Technology both cost One Lakh Sixty Thousand in the first year, followed by One Lakh for the second and third years, totaling Three Lakhs Sixty Thousand.
The B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology program is priced at One Lakh Sixty Thousand for the first year and Eighty Thousand for the next two years, with a total fee of Three Lakhs Twenty Thousand.

sections.heading: Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences Reviews
Faculty

content.text: The faculty at Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences are known for their qualifications, real-time experience, and student-friendly teaching methods. Most professors are M.Sc or Ph.D. holders in respective specializations like Cardiac Care, Medical Imaging, and Respiratory Therapy. Students frequently highlight the support they receive from faculty both academically and clinically.

sections.heading: Clinical Exposure and Internship

content.text: Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences is closely associated with Saptagiri Hospital, a fully operational multi-specialty hospital. Clinical training begins from the second year, and students are rotated through departments like Radiology, Anesthesia, Emergency, ICU, and Cardiology. This ensures strong clinical grounding and readiness for job roles upon graduation. Internships are compulsory and provided in the same hospital or partner institutions, making the transition from classroom to clinical care seamless and effective.

sections.heading: Placement Support

content.text: The placement cell in Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences provides excellent support in helping students secure jobs in reputed hospitals such as Narayana Health, Manipal Hospitals, Fortis, and Aster. Special focus is given to courses like Cardiac Care and Medical Imaging for students to make their career in respective field.

sections.heading: Infrastructure

content.text: Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences offers best infrastructure tailored for allied health sciences students. Facilities include:

items: Subject-specific labs (Cardiac Lab, Imaging Lab, OT Simulator)
High-end imaging equipment
Simulation mannequins and practice-based learning setups
Smart classrooms and Wi-Fi-enabled campus
Digital libraries and research support
Separate hostels for boys and girls with good food and security

sections.heading: Campus Life

content.text: The campus life at Sapthagiri is vibrant and enriching. Students participate in:

items: Healthcare workshops and seminars
Interdisciplinary conferences
Skill enhancement programs
Cultural events and inter-college competitions
Sports activities to encourage physical well-being

sections.heading: Affordability and Scholarships

content.text: While the Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences fees are slightly higher than some other colleges, the quality of education, hospital integration, and placement support make it worth the investment. The college also offers Installment payment options Scholarships for meritorious and economically disadvantaged students Guidance for educational loans via partnered banks. This makes professional healthcare education more accessible to students from diverse backgrounds.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: The Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences fees structure is designed to provide value for money by combining theoretical learning, practical exposure, and placement support. Students looking for a future-proof career in healthcare should consider Saptagiri as a top choice in Bangalore. With strong academic backing, world-class infrastructure, and real-time clinical training, Sapthagiri stands out among allied health colleges in Karnataka. If you’re ready to take the first step toward a successful healthcare career, contact our Careermudhra team for admission support and secure your seat today.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee for B.Sc Cardiac Care Technology in Saptagiri Institute?

content.text: The fee for B.Sc Cardiac Care Technology in Saptagiri Institute is ₹4,00,000 for the first year and ₹2,00,000 for both second and third years, totaling ₹8,00,000.

sections.heading: Are internships included in the allied health courses at Saptagiri?

content.text: Yes, internships are included in the final year of the course and are provided within Saptagiri Hospital or other partner hospitals.

sections.heading: Is Saptagiri Institute affiliated with RGUHS?

content.text: Yes, all allied health science courses at Saptagiri Institute are affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS), Bengaluru.

sections.heading: Does Saptagiri offer hostel facilities?

content.text: Yes, separate hostels for boys and girls are available on campus with modern amenities including Wi-Fi, laundry, 24/7 security, and nutritious food.

sections.heading: How are placements after completing allied health courses at Saptagiri?

content.text: Placement support is active and robust. Students are placed in leading hospitals especially for Imaging, Cardiac, and Respiratory courses.
